title: 第十一章 华雄夜袭（上）

content_zh:
“吕将军？”关羽转身看向威风凛凛，比自己还高上一丝的吕布。
“关将军果然是神勇，一招就将华雄击退，在下佩服。”吕布讪讪一笑，急忙说道，没想到温酒斩华雄因为自己出面，导致华雄落荒而逃，无心之间放过了自己的大仇人。
“吕将军，这？”关羽有些难以适应战场的变化，按说华雄连斩两将，不可能自己刚上场就落荒而逃，不符合常理。
“关将军神勇盖世，击败了华雄，本将自当在盟主面前为你请功。”吕布笑道。
关羽也不是迂腐之人，自然明白吕布是为自己好，自己兄弟三人，需要的便是功名“如此多谢吕将军了。”对吕布感官不错的关羽出声谢道。
正在帐内商量如何应对华雄的诸侯们忽然听到营寨外鼓声大振，喊声震天，众人失色，料想关羽肯定是折在了华雄手中，火爆脾气张飞更是直接冲出营帐。
“报，关羽仅一合便击败华雄，华雄逃入关内。”
帐内诸侯闻言面面相觑，连斩两名联军大将的华雄，被关羽一招击败了，这是何等的武力，袁绍看向关羽的目光也有些热切。
吕布、关羽并肩走入大帐，只是关羽的脸色有些怪异，众人也没放在心上。
“俺二哥败了华雄，何不就此杀入关内，生擒董卓，更待什么时候？”张飞按耐不住站出来大声嚷道。
袁术闻言大怒，本来在吕布跟前被揍了一顿丢了面子，手下的将领俞涉也被华雄斩杀，再听到张飞嚷嚷，心中火起“大臣尚自前让，量你一县令手下小卒，安敢在此胡言乱语、耀武扬威，来人啊，赶出帐去。”
吕布上前摆摆手说道：“会盟之时有言，有功者赏，有过者罚，既然关将军立下如此大功，怎能如此对待？请盟主定夺！”
“哼，匹夫之勇罢了，若是我上将纪灵在此，岂会容华雄小儿猖狂。”袁术冷哼道，想到之前吕布的野蛮行径，他不敢再拿自己的身体开玩笑。
“公路，关将军有功，当赏，暂且记下，待击破董卓老贼之后再行封赏。”袁绍急忙呵斥道，本来之前袁术不发孙坚粮草致使兵败，已经让诸侯有些寒心，如果再冒大不韪将刘关张赶出去，联军恐怕会有瓦解之危。
诸侯讨董，为的是功名利禄，这必将是彪炳史册的功绩，至于真正攻打董卓，算了吧，能减少损失就尽量减少，这年头没有傻子。
“你，你们……”袁术没想到袁绍这个庶子也敢反驳自己“既然你们只看重一马弓手和几个匹夫，本将军这就离去。”
“走吧，没人拦着你。”吕布笑道。
“你！”袁术脸色涨红。
“公路，且稍待。”袁绍帮衬道。
“此酒尚温。”曹操将酒递给关羽，上前劝道：“岂能因一小事而坏联军之大事，讨董之事，迫在眉睫，还望诸位同心合力。”

公孙瓒见此，将刘关张三人带领回寨，好生安抚。
“什么，华雄竟然败退？”董卓眯起双眼，心中有一丝不妙的感觉，西凉军虽然兵强马壮，却是缺乏英勇善战的将领，如果任由事态发展下去，极有可能会导致汜水关丢失，雒阳就危险了，再加上诸侯兵多，只需围困，就没有自己的活路。
董卓不想成为诸侯们上位的垫脚石，更不想刚刚得到的权势就这么拱手让出去。
“相国，贼势浩大，且诸侯联军之中有吕布等猛将，如今华将军方败，联军士气高昂，正当挫一下他们的锐气。”李儒低声道。
“哦，不知文优有何妙计？”
“相国，如今袁绍为联军盟主，袁绍叔父袁隗，为朝中太傅，若是里应外合，恐怕雒阳城有失，不若除之，且诸侯之中，多有家眷在雒阳城内，如此便会投鼠忌器，使诸侯离心，同时也让雒阳城内宵小不敢有其他动作。”
董卓点头笑道：“文优之计甚妙，诸侯有家眷在雒阳，不怕他们不害怕，就先拿袁隗一家祭旗。”
“相国高见。”
“李傕，郭汜，你二人立即领兵五百，包围太傅府，无论男女老幼，尽皆诛杀，而后你二人领兵五万，助华雄守住汜水关，是为大功一件，援军随后便至。”
“诺。”李傕郭汜出列抱拳道。
“云长，不要放在心上，袁术小儿心胸狭窄，不是君子，何必和他一般见识，关将军温酒败华雄，此等功劳，定当名震天下。”吕布端起酒盏笑道，一字之差没想到竟然是自己造成的。

"General Lu?" Guan Yu turned around and looked at Lu Bu, who was majestic and slightly taller than himself.
"General Guan is really brave. He knocked back Hua Xiong with one move. I admire you." Lu Bu smiled and said hurriedly. He didn't expect that because of his intervention, Hua Xiong fled, and he unintentionally let his biggest enemy go.
"General Lu, what is this?" Guan Yu had some difficulty adapting to the changes on the battlefield. It is said that Hua Xiong killed two generals in a row, and it was impossible for him to escape as soon as he came on the battlefield. It was against common sense.
"General Guan is extremely brave and defeated Hua Xiong. I will take credit for you in front of the leader of the alliance." Lu Bu said with a smile.
Guan Yu was not a pedantic person, so he naturally understood that Lu Bu was doing it for his own good. What his three brothers needed was fame. "Thank you so much, General Lu." Guan Yu, who had a good sense of Lu Bu, thanked him.
The princes who were discussing how to deal with Hua Xiong in the tent suddenly heard loud beating of drums and loud shouts outside the camp. Everyone was pale. They expected that Guan Yu must have been defeated by Hua Xiong. Zhang Fei was so angry that he rushed out of the camp.
"Report, Guan Yu defeated Hua Xiong in just one move, and Hua Xiong fled into the pass."
The princes in the tent looked at each other in shock after hearing this. Hua Xiong, who had killed two allied generals in a row, was defeated by Guan Yu with one move. What kind of force was this? Yuan Shao looked at Guan Yu with eager eyes.
Lu Bu and Guan Yu walked into the tent side by side, but Guan Yu's face looked a little strange, so no one paid attention to it.
"My second brother defeated Hua Xiong, why not just rush into the pass and capture Dong Zhuo alive? How long will it take?" Zhang Fei couldn't help but stood up and shouted loudly.
Yuan Shu was furious when he heard this. He was beaten up in front of Lu Bu and lost face. His general Yu She was also beheaded by Hua Xiong. Then he heard Zhang Fei shouting and became angry in his heart: "I still step aside, minister. You are a county magistrate's subordinate. How dare you talk nonsense and show off your power here? Come on, get out of the tent."
Lu Bu stepped forward and waved his hands and said: "When we met with the alliance, we said that those who have made merit will be rewarded, and those who have made mistakes will be punished. Since General Guan has made such great achievements, how can he be treated like this? Let the leader of the alliance make a decision!"
"Hmph, it's just a common man's bravery. If my general, Ji Ling, were here, how could I allow Hua Xiong to be so rampant?" Yuan Shu snorted coldly. Thinking of Lu Bu's barbaric behavior before, he didn't dare to joke about his body anymore.
"Highway, General Guan has made great contributions and should be rewarded. I'll note it down for the time being. I will award the reward after defeating the old thief Dong Zhuo." Yuan Shao hurriedly yelled. Yuan Shu's failure to send Sun Jian's food and grass led to the defeat, which had already chilled the princes. If Liu, Guan, and Zhang were driven out again at the risk of violence, the coalition might be in danger of collapse.
The princes attacked Dong for fame and wealth, which will surely be a feat that will shine through the annals of history. As for actually attacking Dong Zhuo, forget it. Just try to reduce the losses as much as possible. There are no fools these days.
"You, you..." Yuan Shu did not expect that Yuan Shao, a bastard, would dare to refute him. "Since you only value one horse archer and a few men, I, the general, will leave now."
"Let's go, no one will stop you." Lu Bu said with a smile.
"You!" Yuan Shu's face turned red.
"Highway, wait a moment." Yuan Shao helped.
"This wine is still warm." Cao Cao handed the wine to Guan Yu and stepped forward to persuade him: "How can we ruin the major affairs of the coalition because of a small incident? The fight against Dong is imminent. I hope you all can work together."
Seeing this, Gongsun Zan led Liu, Guan, and Zhang back to the stronghold to appease them.
"What, Hua Xiong actually retreated?" Dong Zhuo narrowed his eyes and had a bad feeling in his heart. Although the Xiliang army was strong and strong, it lacked brave and capable generals. If the situation was allowed to develop, it would most likely lead to the loss of Sishui Pass and Luoyang would be in danger. In addition, there were many soldiers from the princes, and they would have no way of survival if they were besieged.
Dong Zhuo did not want to become a stepping stone for the princes to rise to power, nor did he want to give up the power he had just gained.
"In the Prime Minister's country, the thieves are powerful, and there are powerful generals such as Lu Bu in the coalition of princes. Now General Hua's army has been defeated., the morale of the coalition forces is high, and it is time to dampen their spirit. "Li Ru whispered.
"Oh, I wonder if Wenyou has any clever ideas? "
"Prime Minister, now Yuan Shao is the leader of the alliance, and Yuan Shao's uncle Yuan Wei is the imperial tutor in the court. If we cooperate with each other internally and externally, I am afraid that Luoyang City will be damaged and cannot be eliminated. Moreover, many of the princes have their families in Luoyang City. This will cause the princes to alienate, and at the same time, Xiaoxiao in Luoyang City will not dare to do anything else. "
Dong Zhuo nodded and said with a smile: "Wen You's plan is very clever. The princes have their families in Luoyang. If you are not afraid of them, let's sacrifice the flag to Yuan Kai's family first. "
"Best regards, Prime Minister. "
"Li Jue and Guo Si, you two immediately led 500 troops to surround Taifu's Mansion and killed all of them, men, women, old and young. Then you two led 50,000 troops to help Hua Xiong defend Sishui Pass. This is a great achievement. Reinforcements will arrive soon. "
"No. "Li Jue and Guo Si came out to hold their fists.
"Yun Chang, don't take it to heart. Yuan Shu is a narrow-minded kid. He is not a gentleman. Why should he be acquainted with him? General Guan Wenjiu defeats Hua Xiong. Such achievements will surely shock the world. "Lu Bu picked up the wine cup and said with a smile. Unexpectedly, the difference in one word was caused by himself.
